_comment: FM-1 pre-migration snapshot lock for PL-FRESH-YES-OBLIG. Two assertions in schemaFixtureFactory.test.ts: (1) live hand-written PL_FRESH_YES_OBLIG.payload in formPathScenarios.ts deep-equals this snapshot; (2) toScenario(PL_FRESH_YES_OBLIG_JOURNEY).payload deep-equals this snapshot.
_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — hand-written PL_FRESH_YES_OBLIG.payload carried (a) urgencyLevel: 'STANDARD' and (b) existingBankRelationship: 'YES' — neither value matches current schema option sets (schema options are immediate/soon/planning for urgencyLevel and yes/no for existingBankRelationship). The hand-written payload was authored as a target shape rather than produced by buildLoanPayload(). Corrections: (1) dropped urgencyLevel — not set by the journey (loanRequirementPage question exists but optional; journey only sets loanAmount); (2) dropped existingBankRelationship — same reason; (3) obligation entry gains remainingLimit:'0' + utilizedAmount:'0' from cleanObligationEntries() defaults; (4) obligation.id pinned to 'obl-pl-fresh-1' (was crypto.randomUUID() per the obligation() helper — not suitable for a deterministic snapshot).
